identity.fullname: Build an Agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio
identity.summary: A practice-oriented path aligned to the Microsoft Applied Skills assessment APL-6006, "Build an agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio". Built from the assessment's own preparation modules on Microsoft Learn, it walks through creating and publishing an agent, designing topic-based conversations, grounding the agent with knowledge and generative AI, and adding a workflow tool.

brief.topic: Build an Agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio
brief.audience: App makers and business users with basic familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio who want to build a custom agent end to end, including anyone preparing for the APL-6006 Applied Skills assessment
brief.intended_learning_outcome: Build, configure, and publish a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent that uses topics for guided conversations, is grounded with knowledge and generative AI, and calls a workflow tool

sources.title: Microsoft Applied Skills: Build an agent in Microsoft Copilot Studio
sources.activity_purpose: Understand exactly what the APL-6006 assessment expects you to do so you can focus your practice on the right tasks.

sources.title: Get started with Microsoft Copilot Studio
sources.activity_purpose: Create, configure, test, and publish a working agent using the standard authoring experience.

sources.title: Design agent conversations using topics
sources.activity_purpose: Author and configure topics so the agent follows deliberate, branching conversation paths.

sources.title: Build intelligent agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio
sources.activity_purpose: Ground the agent in knowledge sources and tune its generative-answer and moderation settings.

sources.title: Add structured automation to agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio
sources.activity_name: Add a tool to the agent
sources.activity_purpose: Add a deterministic workflow tool to the agent and wire its inputs and outputs.
